ja: この商品、いつ再入荷するか分かりますか？
en: Do you know when this will be restocked?
alternatives: Can you tell me when this will be restocked?
Do you know when you'll get more of these?
point: 間接疑問は when のあとが平叙文の語順

ja: この近くに文房具屋、ありますか？
en: Is there a stationery store near here?
alternatives: Is there a stationery shop nearby?
Is there a stationery store around here?
point: 「〜はありますか」は Is there 〜? で始める

ja: セールのときに買っておけばよかったなあ。
en: I wish I'd bought it during the sale.
alternatives: If only I'd bought it during the sale.
I wish I had gotten it on sale.
point: 過去の後悔は wish のあとを過去完了 I'd bought にする

ja: これ、今日セールですか？
en: Is this on sale today?
alternatives: Is this discounted today?
Is this item on sale today?
point: 「セール中」は on sale。be 動詞を文頭に出して疑問文に

ja: 見てるだけです、ありがとう。
en: I'm just looking, thanks.
alternatives: I'm only looking, thank you.
Just looking, thank you.
point: 「見ているだけ」は進行形で I'm just looking

ja: 店員に在庫を調べてほしいんだ。
en: I want the clerk to check stock.
alternatives: I'd like the clerk to check stock.
I want a clerk to check the stock.
point: want + 人 + to do。want the clerk check とは言わない

ja: 彼女は今、レジで払ってるよ。
en: She's paying at the register.
alternatives: She's paying at the checkout.
She's paying at the counter.
point: 今している最中は be + 動詞ing。pay の ing は paying

ja: 知ってたら、二つ買ったのに。
en: If I'd known, I'd have bought two.
alternatives: I'd have bought two if I'd known.
Had I known, I'd have bought two.
point: 「知ってたら」は had known、帰結は would have + 過去分詞

ja: このコート、返品できないかなと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if I could return this coat.
alternatives: I was hoping I could return this coat.
Would it be possible to return this coat?
point: 「できないかと思って」は I was wondering if で過去形にして和らげる

ja: 欲しい色が売り切れで、妹は別の色で妥協した。
en: Finding her color sold out, my sister settled for another.
alternatives: Her color was sold out, so she settled for another.
Her color sold out, so my sister settled for another.
point: 分詞構文の主語は主節と同じ人。「妥協する」は settle for

ja: 小さすぎたから、そのセーターは送り返したよ。
en: It was too small, so I sent it back.
alternatives: It was too small, so I returned it.
I sent it back because it was too small.
point: 「送り返す」は send back。代名詞は back の前に置く

ja: レシートなしでも返品できますか？
en: Can I return it without a receipt?
alternatives: Could I return it without a receipt?
Can I return it without one?
point: 「〜なしで」は without + 名詞

ja: 気になるのは、このカメラの保証期間なんです。
en: What worries me is this camera's warranty period.
alternatives: What I'm concerned about is this camera's warranty.
The thing that worries me is the camera's warranty.
point: 「気になるのは〜」は What worries me is 〜 で言える

ja: 妻はもう1時間、ソファを見比べてる。
en: My wife's been comparing sofas for an hour.
alternatives: My wife's been looking at sofas for an hour.
My wife has been sofa shopping for an hour.
point: 今も続く動作は has been comparing、過去形にしない

ja: このコート、返品か交換かで迷ってる。
en: I'm torn between returning it and exchanging it.
alternatives: I'm torn between a return and an exchange.
I can't decide whether to return or exchange.
point: between の後は returning と exchanging を動名詞でそろえる

ja: 昨日買ったシャツ、返品できますか？
en: Can I return a shirt bought yesterday?
alternatives: Can I return the shirt I bought yesterday?
Could I return the shirt I got yesterday?
point: 「買った」は後ろから名詞を修飾。bought yesterday を後ろに置く

ja: 試着室が混んでても、待って試着したいな。
en: Even if the fitting room's full, I'll wait and try it.
alternatives: I'll wait for a fitting room, even if it's packed.
Even if I have to queue, I'm trying this on.
point: Even if の節は未来のことでも現在形で言う

ja: ネットで家具を買う前に、もう少し情報が欲しいな。
en: Before I buy furniture online, I'd like more information.
alternatives: I'd like more information before I buy furniture online.
Before buying furniture online, I want some more information.
point: furniture も information も数えられない名詞。a や -s は付けない

ja: このモデル、もう販売終了ですか？
en: Has this model been discontinued?
alternatives: Is this model discontinued?
Have they stopped making this model?
Has this model already been discontinued?
point: 「販売終了になった」は現在完了の受け身

ja: ネットで、半額の靴を見つけたよ。
en: I found half-price shoes online.
alternatives: I found shoes online for half price.
I found shoes online at half price.
point: 「見つけた」は過去形 found。half-price は名詞の前でつなぐ

ja: 荷物、先週発送されたのにまだ届かない。
en: It shipped last week but hasn't arrived.
alternatives: It was shipped last week but hasn't arrived.
It shipped last week but still hasn't arrived.
It shipped last week but hasn't come yet.
point: 発送は過去形、「まだ届かない」は現在完了 hasn't arrived

ja: サイズは両方試着したほうがいいよ。
en: You should try on both sizes.
alternatives: You should try both sizes on.
It's better to try on both sizes.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should＋動詞の原形

ja: 彼女が買ったバッグ、どこで売ってるか店員さんに聞いて。
en: Ask the clerk where the bag she bought is sold.
alternatives: Ask the clerk where I can get the bag she bought.
Ask the clerk where they sell the bag she bought.
point: 間接疑問は where のあと肯定文の語順にする

ja: あの店員、返金を断っただけでなく謝りもしなかったんだ。
en: Not only did the clerk refuse a refund, he never apologized.
alternatives: The clerk not only refused a refund but never even apologized.
Not only did the clerk refuse to refund me, he didn't apologize.
point: Not only を文頭に出すと did + 動詞原形の倒置になる

ja: ここで一番安い卵はどれですか？
en: Which eggs are the cheapest here?
alternatives: Which eggs here are the cheapest?
What are the cheapest eggs here?
point: 最上級には the を付けて the cheapest

ja: 姉はスカートを直してもらった。
en: My sister had her skirt altered.
alternatives: My sister got her skirt altered.
My sister had her skirt fixed.
point: 「直してもらう」は have + 物 + 過去分詞

ja: 吸引力の強い小型掃除機、おすすめしてもらえますか？
en: Could you recommend a compact vacuum with strong suction?
alternatives: Can you recommend a small vacuum with powerful suction?
Is there a compact vacuum with strong suction you'd recommend?
point: 「吸引力の強い掃除機」は名詞のあとに with で修飾する

ja: 大きいほうにしてれば、今ごろ返品してないのに。
en: If I'd gone bigger, I wouldn't be returning this.
alternatives: Had I gone bigger, I wouldn't be returning this now.
If I'd sized up, I wouldn't be returning this now.
point: 過去の条件と今の結果を組み合わせ、後半は would be -ing

ja: 買う決め手は、店員じゃなくレビューだったよ。
en: It was the reviews, not the clerk, that sold me.
alternatives: What sold me was the reviews, not the clerk.
It wasn't the clerk but the reviews that sold me.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that で挟み、not で対比する

ja: 小さいの、見せて。
en: Show me a smaller one.
alternatives: Let me see a smaller one.
Show me a smaller size.
point: 命令文は動詞で始める。「小さいの」は a smaller one

ja: 店員さんは、金曜まで入荷しないって言ってた。
en: The clerk said it wouldn't arrive until Friday.
alternatives: The clerk said it wouldn't be in until Friday.
He said they wouldn't get it until Friday.
point: said に合わせて won't を wouldn't にずらす

ja: 着いたときには、もうセールは終わってた。
en: The sale had already ended when I arrived.
alternatives: The sale had already finished when I arrived.
The sale was already over when I arrived.
point: 着く前に終わっていた出来事は過去完了 had ended

ja: この靴、サイズが合わなかったので返品しに来ました。
en: I came to return these shoes; they didn't fit.
alternatives: I'm here to return these shoes because they didn't fit.
These shoes didn't fit, so I came to return them.
point: 「〜しに来た」は came to + 動詞の原形

ja: 私は店員に在庫を調べてくれるよう頼んだ。
en: I asked the clerk to check stock.
alternatives: I asked a clerk to check inventory.
I asked the salesperson to check stock.
point: ask + 人 + to do。「頼んだ」は asked、to の後は原形

ja: もう少し安ければ、これ買うのに。
en: If it were cheaper, I'd buy it.
alternatives: I'd buy it if it were cheaper.
If it cost less, I'd buy it.
I'd take it if it were cheaper.
point: 現在の仮定は if 節を過去形に。be は主語に関係なく were
